billingDistinctions.claim: Published API prices are token tariffs, not observed charges for OpenCodex or a subscription-authenticated CLI. A model name alone does not establish the billing route.
Codex subscription/credit usage and API-key token billing are different access paths; API-key access is billed at API rates.

A retrieved Claude Code model-configuration source states that Fable requires usage credits even within a subscription allowance. Independent verification was inconclusive after direct403 retrieval; treat this statement as unverified, not account-level billing evidence. The same source lists Opus as the default on Max/Team Premium/Enterprise.

Claude Code can consume tokens for background conversation summarization and status processing. Auxiliary model usage, if present in parent-held records, must be separated from the selected answer model; it does not by itself prove a primary rewrite identity or cash charge.
OpenAI reasoning tokens are billed at output rates. Anthropic thinking also consumes billable output. Visible answer length alone is insufficient for cost estimation.
Claude Batch API discounts input/output by 50%; prompt caching has separate write/read rates. The modern 1M Claude models in this shortlist have no long-context token-price premium.
No per-rewrite, monthly, currency-converted or observed study cost is calculated here.

shortlist.rationale: Vendor capability positioning justifies inclusion, not a winner. Preserve claim, number, polarity and causation checks separately for KO/EN/ZH/JA.
shortlist.effortPlan: Keep the existing low OpenAI/high Claude controls. Parent may compare supported efforts on the same inputs after route admission; max requires a measured benefit.

shortlist.rationale: Price/latency positioning makes these useful candidates. Lower API price is not measured latency or lower CLI cash spend.
shortlist.effortPlan: Compare none/low where supported for OpenAI; use low or disabled thinking only where the Claude route admits it. Fable cannot disable thinking. Haiku does not accept effort.

shortlist.rationale: Use schema-constrained outputs and a separately identified judge. Schema validity is not factual correctness, human agreement or score calibration.
shortlist.effortPlan: Measure repeat stability and agreement with authorized labeled data; report missing labels as missing. Admit the actual model/route, reject refusal/truncation/invalid JSON and preserve deterministic scoring as a separate signal.

compatibilityNotes.claim: GPT-6 Astra has no none effort. It supports Chat Completions text requests, but tool calling requires Responses. temperature, top_p and logprob-related parameters are unsupported.
Claude Sonnet 5 rejects manual extended thinking and non-default temperature/top_p/top_k. Opus 5 cannot disable thinking at xhigh/max. Fable 5.1 always uses adaptive thinking.
Use output_config.format for Claude JSON schemas and the documented OpenAI structured-output field for the selected endpoint. Direct API capabilities do not establish proxy or native CLI passthrough.
The newest models use different tokenizers. Equal characters or nominal output-token caps do not establish equal multilingual payload size or compute; compare the same source texts.
